title.en: Viral AI startup Instinct has raised $350 million at a $2.5 billion valuation

title.en: Amazon just tripled its order of Nvidia chips over ‘surging demand’

summary.zh: 亚马逊将在未来两年内为其数据中心增加200万个Nvidia GPU芯片。但这种扩展的合作伙伴关系不仅仅是购买更多的芯片。
